create_mouse_target: create a QtStimulus mouse hover target rectangle with configurable position, size, and color
create_mouse_target_with_hover_callbacks: create a mouse target that triggers create_end_timer on hover enter and cancel_end_timer on hover leave
create_random_position_mouse_target: create a mouse target with a randomly generated position within the stimulus window bounds
create_custom_duration_mouse_target: create a mouse target stimulus with a custom display duration instead of the default INFINITE
create_styled_mouse_target: create a mouse target with custom brush color, pen color, width, height, and hover delay time
